name: acf-whip
description: Hostile workflow enforcer. Zero tolerance backlog automation from decomposition to acceptance with aggressive quality gates. /task and /go run as dynamic workflows (deterministic loop, schema-enforced worktree slugs, integrity-gated) when available, with the legacy single-context loop as automatic fallback. Self-heals pre-2.0.0 backlogs: the doctor derives missing worktree slugs for active tasks and treats accepted/historical tasks as advisory (never blocking); /go counts branchless historical accepted tasks as terminal. Planning and execution default to maximum parallelism of non-conflicting work.
